provenance.selection: OrderID IN (1,2,3,4,5,80,81,82,83,84); referenced dimensions plus IDs 1..11 for course simulation
provenance.transforms: order_amount = SUM(OrderLines.Quantity * UnitPrice), excludes tax; no payment or status inferred
